title: CompactDoc
description: The compact encoding used as the editor model. Three node forms: a typed node, a literal, and a name reference. Keys are words rather than punctuation, because this document is read and edited by hand and sits beside JSON-LD keywords; size is a matter for transport compression, not for the vocabulary. Required fields are reconstructed by the decoder, so this form does not carry them.

type.description: A syntax node type such as While, or, for a collapsed constructor, the class name as a bare term followed by any declared co-types. One key, because both answer the same question: what this is.

order.description: Syntactic sibling slot, materialized during elision.

span.description: Optional [lineno, col, endLineno, endCol]; the join key for the editor, the trace overlay and in-place patching. Needed only to patch the original file, not to regenerate code.

oneOf.description: A typed node: a syntax node, or a collapsed constructor carrying its fields directly.
